name: Timebomb Duels [Alpha]
desc:
To ensure the best possible experience, please make sure that you are in a server with the lowest ping possible.

The game is currently in Alpha. It will be further developed during the coming months. All stats will be wiped after each stage concludes. It is anticipated that there will be bugs and glitches.

We kindly ask for your patience as we look into and address any problems that arise. You can speed up the process by reporting any bugs you happen to find.
